title: Auto-Suggestion: The Medium for Influencing the Subconscious Mind
coreMove: Auto-suggestion works when a precise money aim is repeated with feeling, imagined as already possessed, tied to service, and used to start movement toward plans.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who skim their written aim without feeling it
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a money statement from paperwork into felt instruction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the exact sum and service offered during a morning reading.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose fear phrases replay during work
exampleSpecs.stakes: choose the mental input before it becomes the repeated channel
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use conscious mind, subconscious mind, dominant thoughts, and receiving station as a channel metaphor.

exampleSpecs.audience: service providers who want more income without naming the exchange
exampleSpecs.stakes: connect the desired sum to a specific service promise
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Replace a vague income wish with an exact sum and service offered.

exampleSpecs.audience: independent operators who underprice while claiming a higher aim
exampleSpecs.stakes: let felt possession affect the next visible business move
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the exact sum and service offered to correct an apologetic price.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who let the daily repetition disappear
exampleSpecs.stakes: restore the twice-daily rhythm before drift takes over
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show how missing night readings weakens the exact sum and service offered.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers waiting for a perfect plan before taking one step
exampleSpecs.stakes: turn the chosen mental channel into immediate movement
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Separate fear from the receiving station and act once.
